title: StratumTracker accepts caller-selected policy on every transition
description: Correctness/security review: StratumTracker.adopt, consider, current_time, and status accept an arbitrary SourcePrecedencePolicy per call. Any caller can authorize peers/sources, enlarge step/correction budgets, or extend expiry, bypassing the tracker's persistent correction anchor policy. Bind one immutable policy at construction; require the exact admin capability for explicit policy replacement with defined state reset/preservation semantics.
